basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Junior Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: One Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) post is open in the Department of Design at the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi under the Rekhi Mind Lab project (RP04944N), funded by Rekhi Happiness Academy LLP. The post pays Rs.30,000/- p.m. (Consolidated) on a contractual basis. The essential qualification is a Master in Psychology/Sociology/Design self-efficacy and evidence-based happiness interventions, along with the experience the notice lists. Indian nationals can apply by emailing the filled Form No. IRD/REC-4 to [email protected] by 17 November 2026, 5.00 p.m.

how_to_apply: Download Form No. IRD/REC-4 from the IRD Website of IIT Delhi (http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec).
Fill in the form with complete information on your educational qualifications, indicating the percentage of marks/division.
Give the details of your work experience and the Advertisement Number (IITD/IRD/313/2026) in the form.
Email the duly filled form to Prof. Jyoti Kumar at [email protected].
Write the advertisement number in the subject line of the email.
Send the email by 17/11/2026, 5.00 p.m., the last date for submitting completed applications.
For clarification on eligibility for the post, candidates may contact Prof. Jyoti Kumar at [email protected]. That address is for queries; applications go to [email protected].

Department of Design, IIT Delhi, Hauz Khas, New Delhi

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian nationals only. The notice lists the following as Must Have Qualifications for the Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) post: Master in Psychology/Sociology/Design self-efficacy and evidence-based happiness interventions. Experience in developing academic content, learning modules and coursematerials for a university-level Science of Happiness course. Experience in conducting pre–post research studies using standardised psychological assessment scales. Experience in developing pedagogical content and digital tools for the Science of Happiness. Practical research exposure to EEG/fNIRS-based studies, particularly involving Science of happiness research topics. Experience in systematic literature reviews, research data analysis and academic writing. A 5% relaxation of marks may be granted to SC/ST candidates. The notice does not mention an age limit for this post. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording of this post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) post carries a consolidated pay of Rs.30,000/- p.m. The appointment is on a contractual basis with consolidated pay. It is renewable yearly or up to the duration of the project, whichever is earlier. The Rekhi Mind Lab project runs up to 26/01/2030. If a retired or superannuated government employee is selected, his or her salary will be fixed as per prevailing IRD norms.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists these Key Responsibilities: Conducting research on happiness, well-being and positive psychology. Supporting ongoing psychological and neuroscience-based research studies. Data collection, analysis, report preparation and academic documentation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Delhi Jr. Project Assistant (Tech.)
content_sections.text: For clarification on eligibility for the post, candidates may contact Prof. Jyoti Kumar at [email protected] . That address is for queries; applications go to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing eligible candidates from among those who meet the advertised qualification and the requirement of the project post. The names of the short-listed candidates will be displayed on the web link http://ird.iitd.ac.in/shortlisted, along with the online interview details. Only short-listed candidates will be informed about the online interview. The notice does not give an interview date.
